_help: Hotel and airline programmes for the Perks tab. Each has tiers (name, what it takes, perks) and links: kind status (something gives you status), match (status match) or move (move points), with the url where you do it. Fill English and 繁體 (_zh); build.py makes 简体. rows: the tier comparison table, one value per tier ('y' = yes, '-' = no, else text; vals_zh for 繁體 text). Move links carry rate [points, miles] and bonus (extra miles per 60,000 points).

tiers.name: Member
tiers.perks: Member rates, free Wi-Fi, points on stays.
tiers.perks_zh: 會員價、免費 Wi-Fi、住宿賺積分。

tiers.name: Silver Elite
tiers.perks: 10% bonus points, late check-out when available.
tiers.perks_zh: 額外 10% 積分，視乎情況延遲退房。

tiers.name: Gold Elite
tiers.perks: 25% bonus points, room upgrade when available, 2pm check-out, welcome points.
tiers.perks_zh: 額外 25% 積分、視乎情況升級房間、下午 2 時退房、迎賓積分。

tiers.name: Platinum Elite
tiers.perks: 50% bonus points, lounge access or breakfast, upgrades including some suites, 4pm check-out.
tiers.perks_zh: 額外 50% 積分、酒廊或早餐、升級包括部分套房、下午 4 時退房。

tiers.name: Titanium Elite
tiers.perks: 75% bonus points, upgrades including suites, 48-hour room guarantee.
tiers.perks_zh: 額外 75% 積分、升級包括套房、48 小時保證有房。

tiers.name: Ambassador
tiers.perks: Personal Ambassador service and Your24 flexible check-in and check-out.
tiers.perks_zh: 專屬 Ambassador 服務及 Your24 自選入住退房時間。

links.title: Gold Elite with Amex Platinum
links.title_zh: Amex Platinum 送 Gold Elite
links.what: The Hong Kong Platinum Card gives Marriott Gold Elite. Enrol online.
links.what_zh: 香港 Platinum Card 送 Marriott Gold Elite，須網上登記。

links.title: Gold Elite from KrisFlyer
links.title_zh: KrisFlyer 配對 Gold Elite
links.what: KrisFlyer Elite Gold and PPS Club get Marriott Gold Elite for 12 months, and Platinum after 10 nights.
links.what_zh: KrisFlyer Elite Gold 及 PPS Club 會員可獲 12 個月 Marriott Gold Elite，入住 10 晚升 Platinum。

links.title: Points to Asia Miles: 3 to 1
links.title_zh: 積分轉 Asia Miles：3 換 1
links.what: 3 Bonvoy points = 1 Asia Mile, plus 5,000 bonus miles for every 60,000 points.
links.what_zh: 3 Bonvoy 積分 = 1 Asia Mile，每轉 60,000 積分另送 5,000 里數。

links.title: Points to KrisFlyer: 3 to 1
links.title_zh: 積分轉 KrisFlyer：3 換 1
links.what: 3 Bonvoy points = 1 KrisFlyer mile, plus 5,000 bonus miles per 60,000. KrisFlyer miles also move back at 4 miles to 3 points.
links.what_zh: 3 Bonvoy 積分 = 1 KrisFlyer 里數，每 60,000 另送 5,000；KrisFlyer 里數亦可 4 換 3 轉回 Bonvoy。

links.title: Points to Avios: 3 to 1
links.title_zh: 積分轉 Avios：3 換 1
links.what: 3 Bonvoy points = 1 British Airways Avios, plus 5,000 bonus Avios per 60,000.
links.what_zh: 3 Bonvoy 積分 = 1 英航 Avios，每 60,000 另送 5,000。

tiers.name: Diamond
tiers.perks: 100% bonus points, executive lounge access, 48-hour room guarantee.
tiers.perks_zh: 額外 100% 積分、行政酒廊、48 小時保證有房。

tiers.name: Diamond Reserve

tiers.perks_zh: 額外 120% 積分、保證下午 4 時退房、可預先確認升級。

links.title_zh: 積分轉 Asia Miles：5 換 1
links.what: 5 IHG points = 1 Asia Mile.
links.what_zh: 5 IHG 積分 = 1 Asia Mile。

links.what: 10,000 IHG points = 2,000 British Airways Avios.

tiers.name: Classic
tiers.perks: Member rates, usually up to 10% off.
tiers.perks_zh: 會員價，一般最多九折。

tiers.name: Silver
tiers.perks: 24% bonus points, welcome drink, late check-out when available.
tiers.perks_zh: 額外 24% 積分、迎賓飲品、視乎情況延遲退房。

tiers.name: Gold
tiers.perks: 48% bonus points, room upgrade when available, room guarantee.
tiers.perks_zh: 額外 48% 積分、視乎情況升級、保證有房。

tiers.name: Platinum
tiers.perks: 76% bonus points, executive lounge, free breakfast in Asia Pacific.
tiers.perks_zh: 額外 76% 積分、行政酒廊、亞太區免費早餐。

tiers.name: Diamond
tiers.perks: 100% bonus points, dining vouchers, gift Gold status to a friend.
tiers.perks_zh: 額外 100% 積分、餐飲禮券、可送 Gold 會籍給朋友。

links.title_zh: Amex Platinum 送精英會籍

links.what_zh: 2,000 Accor 積分 = 1,000 KrisFlyer 里數，KrisFlyer 里數亦可轉回 Accor。

links.title: Points to Asia Miles: 2 to 1
links.title_zh: 積分轉 Asia Miles：2 換 1

programs.name: Cathay · Asia Miles

tiers.name: Green
tiers.perks: Earn Asia Miles, check in 48 hours early, a lounge pass at 200 status points.
tiers.perks_zh: 賺 Asia Miles、提早 48 小時登記、200 身份積分送貴賓室券。

tiers.name: Silver
tiers.perks: Business lounge, business check-in, priority bags, extra 10kg cabin allowance.
tiers.perks_zh: 商務貴賓室、商務櫃位登記、行李優先、額外 10 公斤手提行李。

tiers.name: Gold
tiers.perks: Bring a guest to lounges, preferred seats, free inflight Wi-Fi.
tiers.perks_zh: 可攜一位賓客進貴賓室、優先選位、免費機上 Wi-Fi。

tiers.name: Diamond
tiers.perks: First class lounges, priority boarding, extra baggage, upgrades.
tiers.perks_zh: 頭等貴賓室、優先登機、額外行李、升級獎勵。

programs.note: Cathay is changing its membership tiers from 1 January 2027 and adding a new Diamond Exec tier.
programs.note_zh: 國泰會員級別將於 2027 年 1 月 1 日起更改，並新增 Diamond Exec 級別。
